rows.text: returns the qword at `rcx + 8*i` where `i = r8d (sign-extended) + 4*(low byte of r9) + 8*(low byte of edx)`
calls `0018B4E0(rcx)` and tail-jumps `0018AFF0(its result, qword rcx+0x10)`

indexes 16-byte records at `00902750` by `i = 27*(ecx AND 3) + 9*((ecx>>2) AND 3) + 3*((ecx>>4) AND 3) + ((ecx>>6) AND 3)` and, into the block p given by the fifth (stack) argument, copies record dwords `+4`, `+8`, `+0xC` to `p+8`, `p+0`, `p+4`, remapping each of `p+0` and `p+4` 6 to `0x11`, 7 to `0x12`, 2 to `0xF` and 3 to `0x10`; when record dword `+0` is 1 it stores 1 to `p+0` if `ecx AND 3` is 0, else to `p+4`; stores record dword `+0` to `p+0x1C`, replaced by 5 when the sixth (stack) argument's byte is non-zero and i is 10; when `p+0x1C` is then 3 or 5 it stores 1 to `p+0` and 0 to `p+4`; stores 0 to `p+0x18` and bits 32-39 of `rcx` divided by 255.0 (`008C5B40`) to `p+0xC`, `p+0x10` and `p+0x14`
calls `00609710(rdx)` and, when its byte result is non-zero, `00600A60(rdx, 3)`; calls `00188730(00189120())`; then, only when that first result was non-zero, calls `005FEFD0(rdx, 0)`
calls `00609710(rdx)` and, when its byte result is non-zero, `00600A60(rdx, 3)`; calls `001893C0(00189120())`; then, only when that first result was non-zero, calls `005FEFD0(rdx, 0)`
copies the five dwords at `rdx+0` to `rdx+0x10` to `rcx+0x108` to `rcx+0x118`

scans the `0x18`-byte records from `02EBEC00` up to `02EBEF60` (36 records) for the first whose dword `+0` equals `ecx` and returns that record's byte `+0x10` zero-extended; returns -1 when none matches
takes the `0x38`-byte record at `02EBCD80 + 0x38*(ecx AND 0x3F)` and returns its dword `+0x30` when the low 6 bits of its dword `+0` equal those of `ecx`, else -1
calls `00629E50(qword rdx+0x30)` when that qword is non-null, and returns 0 on both paths
reads dword `rcx+0x18860` as i, stores 0 to it, and stores and returns the pointer `rcx + 0x10880 + i*0x7FE0` in qword `rcx+0xB8`
with o the qword at `+0x110` of qword `rcx+0x848`, calls o's vtable slot `+0x78` as `(o, qword rcx + 8*(dword rcx+0xB0) + 0xA8, 0)`; then stores 0 to dword `rcx+0xB0` and returns qword `rcx+0xC0`

notes: 001EE650: the fifth and sixth (stack) arguments are read at [rsp+0x28] and [rsp+0x30] with no prior push, so they are the first and second stack slots; the 2/3/6/7 remap order is 6, 7, 2 then 3 via cmove. 0018AA10 uses r8d sign-extended and the low bytes of r9 and edx zero-extended.
